name: Diana W. Young
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Marietta, Georgia

about: A pillar of leadership within her legal community with over four decades of experience, Diana W. Young strives to provide every client with the top-quality legal representation they deserve in their pressing family law matters, ensuring that they are well-taken care of throughout their ordeals. The founding partner at the Young Law Firm, LLC, in Marietta, Georgia, she routinely takes on cases pertaining to divorce and separation, and child custody and support, as well as personal injury law and criminal defense.

Ms. Young completed her undergraduate studies in 1980, graduating with her Bachelor of Arts degree magna cum laude in journalism and political science from the University of Georgia. She went on to attend the University of Georgia School of Law, where her legal acumen and talents were reinforced through her active involvement in numerous on-campus activities. She received her Juris Doctor cum laude in 1983, and in the same year, she obtained her license to practice law in Georgia.

With a client-centric practice that emphasizes personalized attention, meticulous focus and an unwavering work ethic, Ms. Young fights tooth and nail to get her clients the peace of mind they deserve so that they can move on with their lives and onto better opportunities. For her many contributions, she has been peer-review rated AV Preeminent* through Martindale-Hubbell, the organization’s highest rating, and holds a perfect “10.0” score on Avvo, along with many positive client testimonials on the latter site.

Ms. Young maintains close affiliations with myriad legal organizations, including the State Bar of Georgia, the American Bar Association and the Georgia Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers. At the Cobb County Bar Association, she serves as a trustee and editor, and she is a member of the Family Law Section, the Criminal Defense Section and the Women of the Bar Section.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
